name: add_project_domain
description:
Add a domain to a project by domain name, optionally with a git branch, custom environment, or redirect target. If the domain is not yet verified for this project, the result shows verified = false with a verification challenge; complete it with verify_project_domain. Adding a domain already on the project fails.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v10/projects/{idOrName}/domains --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

customEnvironmentId.description: The unique custom environment identifier within the project

anyOf.description: Git branch to link the project domain

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
